body.purpose: Readable scientific values and explanatory copy.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Keep interaction feedback immediate and restrained.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single prominent action for a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #5BE6C7; color: #0B1220; padding: 0 14px; min-height: 32px; border: 1px solid #5BE6C7; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: #35B99D; border-color: #35B99D; }

components.name: Evidence Field
components.description: A dark, focused input well for paths and filters.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #0F192B; color: #EAF2FF; padding: 0 10px; min-height: 32px; border: 1px solid #273750; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #5BE6C7; }

components.name: Active Navigation
components.css: .ds-nav { background: #111B2F; padding: 6px; } .ds-nav-active { display: block; background: #173A3D; color: #5BE6C7; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Evidence Surface
components.description: A flat, layered surface for data and diagnostics.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #16243A; color: #EAF2FF; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #273750; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-card strong { color: #95A7C2; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1px; } .ds-card p { margin: 8px 0 0; }

narrative.overview: FideliChem should feel like a well-kept instrument panel: quiet enough for careful reading, structured enough to expose the state of evidence, and deliberate about every action that can change a workspace. The interface uses tonal layers instead of decorative effects, with one restrained accent reserved for actions, focus, and trustworthy positive state.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: The accent is reserved for an action, an active state, or a focus ring; it is not a decorative fill.

rules.name: The Evidence First Rule
rules.body: Use readable body text for scientific content; labels may be compact, but evidence is never reduced to ornamental microcopy.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface is flat at rest; state changes are communicated by a border, tonal shift, or explicit status label.

dos: Do keep one shared stylesheet and token vocabulary for every view.
Do expose loading, empty, disabled, warning, and error states in text.
Do preserve native keyboard focus and accessible names on inputs.
donts: Don't add gradients, glassmorphism, decorative shadows, or noisy background art to analysis surfaces.
Don't hide missing scientific evidence by replacing it with zero or a reassuring-looking placeholder.
Don't put scientific rules or persistence calls inside view widgets.
